name: @hraness/credits-foundation
description: Prepaid credits for Hraness products: shared money and pricing vocabulary, the credits-required envelope, a CLI adapter for the credits service, and a product backend client.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/node.ts src/server.ts --target node --format esm --outdir dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run test:package
